# Allowlist of strings (or regex patterns prefixed with re:) that should NOT be
# reported by 3_apply_translations.py's English-residual warning check.
#
# - Lines starting with '#' or blank are ignored.
# - Lines starting with 're:' are compiled as Python regular expressions.
# - Other lines are compared (after normalize_text) against the full <a:t> run.
#
# Add organization-specific product names, version strings, and citations here
# to suppress noise from intentional pass-through text.

# Copyright / disclaimer boilerplate
re:^©\s*Copyright Microsoft Corporation\b.*$
re:^©\s*\d{4}\s+Microsoft Corporation.*$

# URLs (kept verbatim)
re:^https?://\S+$
re:^aka\.ms/\S+$

# Number + unit (e.g. '30 GiB', '100 Mbps', '99.9%')
re:^\d+(\.\d+)?\s*(GiB|MiB|KiB|GB|MB|KB|TB|PB|Mbps|Gbps|ms|%|days?|hrs?|hours?|minutes?|seconds?)\s*$

# Range strings (e.g. '500-1000 repository')
re:^\d{1,4}[\-\u2013]\d{1,4}\s*\S*$

# Version strings
re:^v?\d+(\.\d+){1,3}([+\-]\S+)?$
re:^Windows Server \d{4}(\s*R\d)?$
re:^\.NET( Core| \d+)?$

# Resource provider namespaces (Microsoft.XYZ)
re:^Microsoft\.\w+(\.\w+)*$
